name: Furniture Joint
old_description: I am a family man, with roots in the tradition of self reliance. In the morning, I button my flannel and grow more beard; just a real man making real good furniture. I do not strive to be rich, but yearn to provide quality in all things I do. The success of my business does not lean on high volume sales but on having time to devote to designing and creating challenging pieces. My pleasant ambition is to build unique, beautiful things that will be loved and reliable.
about:
The Furniture Joint operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where founder Chad established the business as a sole proprietorship rooted in a tradition of self-reliance. While a founding year is not publicly disclosed, Chad describes himself as a family man who began the venture to create enduring, handcrafted furniture rather than pursue high-volume sales.

The shop produces custom wooden furniture using traditional joinery techniques, emphasizing the natural integrity of each piece. Chad handles design, construction, and client consultation personally, working primarily with locally sourced wood when possible. The operation is scaled for one-off commissions and small batches, with no published facility size or employee count.

The Furniture Joint serves residential clients and interior designers seeking mid-century modern and other custom styles. Projects range from dining tables and rocking chairs to porch swings, each developed through an initial consultation and detailed cost analysis. Clients are encouraged to visit the shop during the build process.

Chad founded the business to counter the trend of disposable, mass-produced furniture, aiming to build pieces that become cherished household fixtures. The differentiators he cites include traditional joinery, a collaborative design process, and a commitment to local materials.
